description.value: The Chilliwack Cultural Centre is the city's flagship arts venue, housing two performance theatres, the Odlum Brown Art Gallery, 21 music studios, and four arts and crafts studios on the territory of the Stó:lō Coast Salish People. Run by the Chilliwack Arts & Cultural Centre Society, it presents live performances, creative classes, and gallery exhibitions year-round, making it a significant cultural stop in the Fraser Valley. A touring cyclist passing through Chilliwack could take in a show, visit the gallery, or explore ongoing creative programming.

No phone number appears in OSM or on the website.
